en: A vintage postcard showing a riverside scene with steamships docked at a pier and a horse-drawn wagon in the foreground. The riverbank is visible, with a few people near the water. The image is monochrome, with printed and handwritten text in German. The words 'Gruss aus Semlin' (Greetings from Semlin) and 'Schiffstation der D.D.S.G. Actien-Gesellschaft' (Shipping station of the D.D.S.G. Joint-stock Company) are printed, along with the publisher's information.
